page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s3 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 4 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio ensures predictable compute performance without resource contention from hyperthreading. However, the 2.0 GB of memory per core represents a lower memory-to-CPU ratio, which may limit memory-intensive applications. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for compute-bound tasks that do not require large memory footprints, such as lightweight web serving, batch processing, and basic computational workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance within the ecs.s3 family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 4 vCPUs and eliminating hyperthreading resource sharing. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB per core, and does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Because there is no bundled local storage, all operating system and application data must reside on external block storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities, making this instance qualitatively cost-effective for compute-focused workloads with low memory requirements. It is suitable for tasks such as lightweight web serving, distributed microservices, and batch processing pipelines.
